verdict.rationale: ClickUp's integrations directory documents native Slack integration (create and update tasks, link unfurls, real-time updates) and native GitHub integration (syncing commits, branches, PRs and issues), and claims 1,000+ tool connections. Google Drive appears only as a data source for the Brain² AI assistant, not as a documented native integration, so that part of the story is under-evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented native Google Drive integration (attach, sync or embed files), independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Create and update ClickUp Tasks from Slack messages, unfurl links with rich details and actions, and receive real-time task updates in Slack channels.
Sync commits, branches, pull requests, and issues between GitHub and ClickUp to track development progress without switching tools.
Brain² taps Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce, and more to get you answers and insights.
Connect over 1,000+ tools to ClickUp for free
